text:
For most healthy adults, a low-carbohydrate diet is safe short to medium term and often helps with weight loss and blood sugar control, though early fatigue, headache, and constipation are common and fiber or micronutrient gaps need planning. It can also reduce high-intensity exercise performance, because rapid glycolytic ATP production depends on carbohydrate availability. People with diabetes on medication, kidney disease, or other conditions should check with a clinician first.
